top.queue.one: All workers share one model and take turns, one at a time, in a fair queue. That is why a job takes minutes, not seconds.
top.queue.slots: {count} brains are attached, so {count} workers can take a turn at the same time. Everyone else waits in this fair queue.
tour.approvals.text: Risky steps, like running a command or changing an existing file, wait here for your yes or no. You can turn approval mode off in Settings.
tour.approvals.title: You stay in control
tour.chat.text: #general is where the crew reports. Write here to steer the job, or open a worker to talk to them directly.
tour.chat.title: Talk to us
tour.crew.text: Dev writes code, Designer does styles, QA checks the work and Writer does docs. The ring shows what each one is doing. We share one model and take turns.
tour.crew.title: Meet the crew
tour.demoRequest: A tiny landing page for a neighborhood bakery: a hero, three breads, opening hours and a contact link.
tour.files.text: All the files the crew writes live in the workspace. Each change comes with a diff, so you always see exactly what changed.
tour.files.title: Every change, visible
tour.lend.text: A friend can lend you their model, or you can lend yours. Only prompts and answers travel; files never leave the computer they are on.
tour.lend.title: Lend your PC
tour.missing: This part is not on the screen right now, so here is what it does.
tour.office.text: Prefer to watch the crew at work? Office mode shows us at our desks while the job runs.
tour.office.title: Office mode
tour.preview.text: The live preview runs the workspace as a site and reloads after each change. Switch between desktop, tablet and phone widths.
tour.preview.title: See it live
tour.refiner.text: Before the crew starts, I turn your words into a clear brief. You see your original next to my improved version, and you can use mine, edit it or keep yours.
tour.refiner.title: I improve your request
tour.replayHint: You can take it again any time from Help, the question mark in the top bar.
tour.request.text: Type what you want built in this box and press Enter. A landing page, a small app, a script, tests or docs: one clear request works best.
tour.request.title: Hi, I am Mel. Start here
tour.settings.text: Pick the model, the language, the voice and approval mode in Settings. The globe in the top bar switches the language right away.
tour.settings.title: Settings and language
tour.timeline.text: The timeline shows every task, who does it and what it waits for. Right click a task to retry it, hand it to someone else or cancel it.
tour.timeline.title: The plan, step by step
tour.try: Try it with a small job
tour.tryDemo: Try it: run the demo job

voice.err.silence: I did not hear anything. Try again a little closer to the microphone.
voice.err.unsupported: This browser cannot turn speech into text. Voice mode works in browsers with speech recognition; you can still type to the crew.
voice.lex.approve: approve|accept the step|allow it|allow the step

voice.privacy: Speech recognition in this browser may send your audio to the browser maker's service to turn it into text. Mel's spoken replies are made on this computer when a local voice is installed.
voice.sample: Hi, I am Mel. Tell me what the crew should build.
voice.say.confirm: {summary} Should I go ahead? Say yes or no.
voice.say.help: You can ask me to build something, ask what the crew is doing, approve or reject the waiting step, open a window like files or the preview, or ask for git and GitHub steps like commit and push.
voice.say.noApprovals: No step is waiting for your approval.
voice.say.noGit: Git and GitHub steps are not available in this hivedesk.
voice.say.nothingPending: There is nothing waiting for an answer right now.
voice.say.started: The request is with the crew. I will improve the brief first.
voice.say.statusEnded: {status, select, done {The last job is done} failed {The last job failed} other {The last job was cancelled}}: {request}
voice.say.statusIdle: The crew is free. Tell me what to build.

voice.say.stillWaiting: I am still waiting for your answer: {summary} Say yes to go ahead or no to cancel.
voice.say.unknown: Sorry, I did not get that. Try: what is the crew doing, open the files, or build a landing page for a bakery.
voice.set.lead: Talk to Mel with the mic button in the top bar or by holding Ctrl and Space. She answers out loud and always asks before she acts.
